remarks: Classic 5-bedroom center hall Colonial nestled on a quiet cul-de-sac in one of Darien's most convenient locations, just a short walk to school. Beautifully sited on a level lot, this meticulously maintained home offers the perfect balance of privacy, outdoor space, and timeless charm. Designed for today's lifestyle, the thoughtfully crafted floor plan flows effortlessly from room to room, while the screened porch and expansive deck create seamless indoor-outdoor living, ideal for year-round entertaining and everyday family life. Move-in ready, the home has been lovingly cared for and thoughtfully updated with numerous quality improvements, including a new high-efficiency boiler and a full whole-house generator for ultimate peace of mind. Enjoy the very best of Darien, with award-winning schools, beautiful beaches and parks, a vibrant downtown filled with exceptional shopping and dining, and convenient access to Metro-North and major highways. This exceptional, turnkey home offers the lifestyle today's buyers are seeking-a rare opportunity not to be missed.
